snippet.title: PRISON OF HUSKS Gameplay Trailer - Future Games Show Summer Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Wishlist here - store.steampowered.com/app/2975260

PRISON OF HUSKS is a nostalgia-tinged soulslike with crunchy graphics and an atmospheric afterlife setting. During the summer showcase, Glass Head Dolls shared an eerie new trailer featuring tense combat and inspired enemy designs. It's coming soon to PS5. 

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS
